name: kling-ai
description: Generate and edit images, create videos from text and reference media, and check your Kling AI credits and generation progress.

interface.longDescription: Create images and videos with Kling AI (可灵AI). Kling Image 4.0 supports text-to-image, reference-image editing, and connected image series, with native resolution up to 8K. Create product photos, posters, portraits, social media content, and videos with one or more shots. Kling 4.0 supports text-to-video, image-to-video with first, last, and intermediate keyframes, and Omni-Ref with images, videos, audio, and reusable subjects (Elements). It produces 3–30 second videos at 720p, with 1080p available to eligible accounts. Kling 4.0 Flash is optimized for speed and produces 3–20 second videos at 720p from text, a single first-frame image, or Omni-Ref with images, videos, and Elements. Both Omni-Ref models support smart shot splitting and a choice between synchronized sound generation and source-video sound retention. Use models with motion control to transfer a saved motion or a reference video to a subject image. Upload reference images, videos, and audio, manage Elements, browse the motion library, check your credit balance, and track generation progress. A connected Kling AI account is required. Generation uses Kling AI credits. Model availability and supported settings vary by account.

Kling 4.0 Flash, 20s at 720p: start with my sneaker photo, slowly orbit the shoe, and end on a close-up of the upper.
